answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, as a result paying the willow bond on all of them and exposing each to the falcon slash. Because the saffron audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 11 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. The deposit is 47 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
